item.subject: science
item.stem:
Eshan learns that Earth's hydrosphere, biosphere, atmosphere, and geosphere are connected, so damage in one system can affect the others. Protection is linked to greenhouse gases, pollution, biodiversity, cleaner energy, and choices such as reusing, repairing, recycling, and saving energy and water.

Which claim best explains how to protect life on Earth?

options.A: Protecting life needs connected actions: cutting greenhouse gases and pollution, protecting biodiversity, using cleaner energy, and choices such as reusing, repairing, recycling, and saving energy and water.
options.B: Protecting only the atmosphere is enough, because the other systems cannot affect each other.
options.C: Connected Earth systems mean that no human action can reduce damage to life.
options.D: Reusing and recycling replace the need to cut greenhouse gases or protect biodiversity.
